RISKS: Vendor lock-in (Impact: High, Likelihood: Medium): Preferred cloud vendor's proprietary services create estimated 30-40% annual switching costs, limiting future negotiation leverage and technology flexibility. Data migration loss (Impact: Medium, Likelihood: High): Legacy database migration carries risk of data corruption or loss during ETL processes, particularly for unstructured operational data spanning 12 years. Timeline overrun (Impact: Medium, Likelihood: Medium): Complex interdependencies between pilot validation, compliance review, and budget approval create schedule risk, especially if any phase encounters delays. Skill gap (Impact: High, Likelihood: Low): Current IT team has limited cloud-native architecture experience; knowledge transfer during migration may be insufficient without targeted upskilling investment. Compliance gap (Impact: Low, Likelihood: High): Evolving APAC data residency regulations may require architecture modifications after initial deployment, particularly if new guidance is issued during the migration window.
ACCEPTED_RISKS: Vendor lock-in: Consciously accepted by CEO with the condition that a contractual exit clause limiting switching costs to 15% of annual spend is negotiated before contract signing. CTO to validate exit clause technical feasibility.
OPPORTUNITIES: Cost reduction (Impact: High, Likelihood: High): Consolidation of on-premise data centers projected to reduce infrastructure costs by 15% ($2.1M annually) starting Year 2, with additional savings from elastic scaling. Infrastructure modernization (Impact: High, Likelihood: Medium): Migration enables adoption of containerized microservices architecture, reducing deployment cycles from weeks to hours and improving system resilience. Talent attraction (Impact: Medium, Likelihood: High): Cloud-native technology stack significantly improves recruitment competitiveness for senior engineering roles, addressing current 6-month average time-to-fill. Competitive advantage (Impact: Medium, Likelihood: Medium): Early adoption of hybrid cloud positions the organization ahead of industry peers, enabling faster product innovation cycles and improved time-to-market.
MITIGATIONS: For data migration loss risk: Implement parallel-run validation with automated data integrity checksums for all critical datasets before cutover. Maintain full rollback capability for 90 days post-migration. For compliance gap risk: Engage external regulatory counsel to monitor APAC regulatory developments monthly and maintain architecture flexibility for multi-region partitioning.
RISK_SOURCES: Vendor lock-in: Technology (primary), Finance (secondary). Data migration loss: Technology (primary), Operations (secondary). Timeline overrun: Operations (primary). Skill gap: Technology (primary). Compliance gap: Legal (primary).
OPPORTUNITY_SOURCES: Cost reduction: Finance (primary), Operations (secondary). Infrastructure modernization: Technology (primary). Talent attraction: Technology (primary). Competitive advantage: Operations (primary), Finance (secondary).
